title: regulatory.completeness_check
description: Structured, rule-based evidence-completeness and conflict check for regulatory-submission integrity (IDMP identity, labeling consistency, commitment tracking, eCTD sequence completeness, variation classification evidence, inspection readiness), over evidence already retrieved and gated. Deterministic given the same evidence set. Stage 21 -- built on the exact same pattern as batch.reconcile.
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a regulatory_completeness graph-run credential. No other workflow may hold this credential (ADR-008).

idempotency.guarantee: Deterministic given the same evidence_ids and policy_contract_version.

evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of evidence_ids returned by evidence.retrieve (regulatory scope) in this run.

reconciliation_complete.description: Whether every required evidence category (identity consistency, labeling consistency, commitment tracking, sequence completeness, variation classification evidence, inspection readiness) has at least one citable item.

findings.description: Structured findings only. No field here or anywhere in this schema represents a regulatory determination.

what_this_schema_cannot_express: Any of these fields would make this tool capable of a Regulatory Affairs decision that belongs exclusively to a human -- ADR-004 layer 1 + layer 2, mirroring batch.reconcile's own pattern exactly.

errors.meaning: An evidence_id was not returned by this run's own retrieval call.
errors.graph_response: abstain -- treat as a gate defect
